result_text:
The "Undefined Team" now only collects active contributors. I haven't added a test for the new behavior.

The change is one condition in `getAllTeams()` in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/landscape/analysis/LandscapeAnalysisResults.java`. An unmatched contributor joins the remainder only if `contributor.getContributor().isActive()` is true. Dormant unmatched contributors are skipped.

Blank latest-commit dates still count as active, because `DateUtils.isDateWithinRange` returns true for a blank date. Configured teams are unaffected: the team-matching branch is unchanged.

I ran `mvn -q -o -pl codeanalyzer test -Dtest='Landscape*'`. It printed nothing and reported no failures. I didn't check whether any `Landscape*` test classes exist, so that run may not have exercised this code.
